_comment: Inventory character preview look (docs/CHARACTERS.md "Character preview", src/gameplay/char_preview_rig.c; char_preview_show reloads it). framing: head_top = the image height above the head top (fraction), crown_m = the head top above the head-top bone (m x the character scale), bottom_t = the image bottom between the hip joints (0) and the knees (1), fov_deg = vertical lens, turn_deg = the character's default turn, square = how much of the idle stance's own turn is undone (0..1). lights: camera space (x right, y up, z towards the camera), linear colours x intensity; the rim lights are point lights placed from the chest point. output: exposure (linear), tonemap neutral | aces, saturation, supersample (samples per side). held.pose: low (the sprint hold) | aim.
